releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.48 — the voice bar behaves like a real player. Seeking used to stop the audio: the whole voice row was a play button, so dragging or tapping the bars landed as a click on the row and toggled playback under your finger. Now only the round button starts and stops a clip. The waveform is a pure scrubber: touch it and the head jumps to your finger, drag and it follows with the bars tinting behind it, and the player is seeked once on release so a fast drag no longer stutters. A thin marker shows exactly where playback will resume, even while paused, and a vertical drag starting on the bars still scrolls the chat instead of being swallowed. Clips are also fetched as soon as the bubble appears — the button shows a spinner while that happens — so pressing play starts instantly instead of downloading first, and every seek is a local read. Photos got the same treatment: a spinner sits inside the frame until the picture is fully decoded, so a slow load no longer looks like a broken image.
